description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with a FastAPI backend for task management, handling authentication, token management, and CRUD operations on tasks.

methods.name: apiFetch(url, { method = "GET", headers = {}, body, token, ...rest } = {})
methods.description: Helper function to perform authenticated JSON fetch requests with error handling.

methods.name: signup({ email, password })
methods.description: Registers a new user by sending credentials to the backend.

methods.name: login({ username, password })
methods.description: Authenticates user and retrieves a JWT token.

methods.name: getMe(token)
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile information.

methods.name: getTasks(token, { status, sort_by, sort_order, skip, limit } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: createTask(token, { title, description, status })
methods.description: Creates a new task for the logged-in user.

methods.name: updateTask(token, task_id, { title, description, status })
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by task_id.

methods.name: deleteTask(token, task_id)
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by task_id.

methods.name: getTask(token, task_id)
methods.description: Fetches a single task by its ID.

ctags.name: apiFetch
ctags.pattern: /^async function apiFetch(url, { method = "GET", headers = {}, body, token, ...rest } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: createTask
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createTask(token, { title, description, status }) {$/

ctags.name: getTasks
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getTasks(token, { status, sort_by, sort_order, skip, limit } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: updateTask
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateTask(token, task_id, { title, description, status }) {$/
